refid / type / asset / amount / fee) and a generic CSV with the canonical
columns ts, t

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "taxlots" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ledger_lint, lp_position_math · Private data: parse_transactions, reconcile_1099da · Public sink: lp_position_math.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ledger_lint, lp_position_math · Private data: parse_transactions, reconcile_1099da · Public sink: lp_position_math

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
